description: Query any Nashville ArcGIS layer by service path + layer id. Full ArcGIS query: where, out_fields, order_by, limit. Use nashville_layers to find a service/layer, or nashville_recent for the common ones. Epoch dates are converted to ISO.

layer.description: Layer id within the service (from nashville_layers), e.g. 39.

service.description: ArcGIS service path, e.g. "hubNashville_311_Service_Requests_2025_view/FeatureServer" (or a short name: crime|service_requests|permits).

name: nashville_query
